performance.verdict: Google is burning $2,582 with near-zero returns; SOW blockers predate every ad dollar spent.

findings.text: 6 SOW milestones overdue since July 31–Aug 1, including LSA verification, site launch, and ads go-live — engagement is 10+ weeks behind plan.
Google Ads consumed $2,581.74 over 28 days and produced only 2 conversions — a cost-per-conversion above $1,290 with no baseline to defend.
Meta is delivering all 26 leads at $58.68 CPL (Meta-only spend basis); 3-day lead signal (Oct 8–10: 0+2+0=2) weaker than prior 3 days (Oct 5–7: 1+4+1=6) — short dip, not collapse.
GHL shows 105 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments — 26 tracked leads against 105 opps suggests intake is not converting; this is a pipeline leak, not an ads problem.
Instagram reach collapsed -54.7% week-over-week (346 avg last 3 days vs ~2,000+ earlier peaks) while Meta ad spend held steady — organic social is fading independently of paid.

suggestions.text: Pause Google Ads Search spend immediately — $2,581.74 spent, 2 conversions, $1,290+ per conversion confirmed over 28 days.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads Search has spent $2,581.74 in the last 28 days and produced only 2 conversions, yielding a cost-per-conversion above $1,290 with no tracking infrastructure confirmed live (SOW milestone overdue since July 31). Pause the campaign now to stop the bleed; reallocate the ~$85/day Google budget to holding until LSA verification and pixel installation are confirmed complete. Success check: zero further Google Search spend until the pre-launch stack test passes and conversion tracking is verified end-to-end — target confirmation by 2026-10-18.

suggestions.text: Escalate 6 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer — LSA verification and pixel install must clear before any Google spend resumes.
suggestions.monday_update: Six SOW milestones are overdue by 10+ weeks, including Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site & Landing Pages, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting Launch, and Shoot 1. Without these, Google conversion data is unreliable and ad spend cannot be defended to the client. Nacer to provide a revised completion date for each item by 2026-10-14. Success check: at least LSA verification submitted and pixel test passed confirmed in writing before Google spend is reactivated.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 105 opportunities, 0 appointments, 0 won — confirm leads are being contacted within 5 minutes as specified in SOW.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 105 opportunities created against 26 tracked ad leads, yet 0 appointments and 0 won cases are recorded — this gap is an intake or pipeline-stage configuration problem, not an ads problem. Pull the contact log for all 105 opportunities and verify first-contact time against the SOW's under-5-minute SLA. Success check: confirm whether leads are being called/texted within 5 minutes and report back by 2026-10-14; if not, routing or automation repair is required before volume is increased.
